about_the_game:
Maid Cafe Coop is a game where you can become a maid with your friends, take it chill or feel the stress of attending a shop with demanding customers.

Features

  • Cafe Management

Assemble and disassemble everything, organize your shop the way you want to help you be more efficient or just to make everything look nice!

  • Multiplayer

Join games or invite your friends over, work together or cause mayhem, watch your friends become the moest maids of them all

  • Entertain customers

There's no maid cafe without a moe moe kyun~! blessing and more. Interact with your customers as they request your attention to make them happy!

  • Customize your character

Explore the extensive character customization, pick your outfit, give yourself tails and ears, set your height and have fun with other special sliders

  • Make many drinks and foods

Unlock new drink and food types that you will have to prepare yourself using different tools and machines!

  • Expand

Grow from a small and cramped cafe into a proper large maid cafe with idol shows filled with moe

  • Concerts

Take part in dances and idol shows stealing the hearts of all your customers

  • Clean

Keep the cafe nice and tidy making sure every cup and floor looks shiny

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: i5 3550 / RYZEN 5 2500X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD R9 270X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Become a cute maid in a maid cafe! Prepare to harness your inner moe energy by preparing and serving customers many different drinks and foods with proper Moe Moe Kyun~ hospitality, and unlock new ways to make them happier. Play singleplayer or with your friends!
supported_languages:
English*, Spanish - Spain, Spanish - Latin America
*languages with full audio support
